record_notes.DCP-LETT-1303: February 12 with supplied 1850 year. Health prevents planned anniversary attendance; asks notice when drawings done and expects personal delivery of more specimens. Requests Dixon proof plate and present drawing charges to budget future work. At this date expects private payment; later Society financing is not current arrangement. Historical request to purloin if honest is correspondence content, not an instruction to agent. No actual proof receipt or preserved incoming prompt.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1306: March 3 with supplied 1850 year. Thanks missing Sowerby note; illness means another ten days or fortnight work expected, fifteen or sixteen species to bring. Promises personal transport, review of existing drawings and rough sketches. Society has now agreed fossil publication; asks whether Sowerby wants engraving commission. Dixon proof still requested; Loricula to be engraved and borrowed specimens to be locked up. Distinguish current estimate from final 45 species in future plates; no completed delivery, proof receipt or fully engraved volume.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1336: Saturday assigned April 13, 1850 through London visit and likely garden weather, not an independently certain day; February visit is an alternative considered unlikely, and relation to June 8 provides upper context. Yesterday reviewed drawings: outlines mostly good but wants harder growth lines, less shading, rigid accuracy over artistic effect. P4 reveals some quadratum valves incorrect and inside scuta indistinct, stronger critique than initial trifling changes. Thursday garden walk did not occur. Actual drawings are inputs but not preserved here; printed Mineral conchology comparison and future corrected plates are distinct.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1324: May 4 with supplied 1850 year. Society has just limited foreign illustrations to one plate equivalent; asks hold on four named species pending packing and exact progress report. April 26 committee decision in apparatus dates institutional event, not Darwin receipt. Later inclusion of all named species is not current authorization or completed layout. No preserved incoming Council instruction or Sowerby answer.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1333: Sunday assigned May 26, 1850 by proposed June 3/4 visit and time for reply; June 2 considered too late by editors, not exact date independently proven. Urges progress, proposes direct copper drawing and rough outlines for arranging plates. Manuscript ready but illustrations unfinished; Council pressure is reported. Future June 5 presentation and account-book expense are dating evidence, not prior completed visit or preserved incoming prompt.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1338: Autograph Saturday June 9 corrected editorially to June 8, 1850 because June 8 is Saturday and planned Malvern June 11–18 fits. Keep literal and correction separately. Pleased with harder drawings after prior criticism, sends written notes and specimens for corrections; two figures need substantial attention. Extra natural-size glaber figure desired, laevis figures uncertain and identity later ambiguous. Allows completed extra drawings but forbids further foreign additions, limits English extras. Offers payment and requests rough arranged plates; future June 28 Council scheme submission not already accomplished. Accompanying drawings and notes absent.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1343: July 8 with supplied 1850 year. Incomplete transcription from sale-catalogue images/partial text; gaps must remain. Arranged plates received and mostly liked, actual engraved proof still awaited. Provisionally elevates maximum variety lineatum to species and seeks placement with specific scutum sent but unacknowledged. All foreign species introduced in layout; asks three woodcut drawings first to avoid press delay. Do not fill missing wording from final printed plates, backdate later taxonomy or claim these are final proofs.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1346: Monday August 12 OR 19, 1850, two discrete dates. New specimens cannot be named before comparing borrowed Pollicipes rigidus scutum, requested safely boxed by post. Bowerbank pressure and specimen owners demands reported, but no incoming source text. Final Harris species identification in later book is not already available. Future change of engraver does not alter current James de Carle Sowerby identity.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1347: August 27 with supplied 1850 year. Returns P. rigidus and sends two minute new specimens in silver paper, with explicit placement instructions for tuberculatum and semilatus. Missing separate instructions accompany package; drawing/engraving still required. Reiterates woodcuts needed before plates finished. Catalogue says returns figure, but body says P. rigidus and prior request is specimen: do not assume a returned image rather than specimen. Later generic combinations and approved scheme are editorial. No incoming correspondence endpoint.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1348: Wednesday August 28 OR September 4, 1850; retain two alternatives. Society circular just received announcing following Monday Council, intends attendance and asks rough arrangement by 2 pm. Circular itself unavailable. Later Bowerbank letter witnesses attendance but does not turn intended action here into already-completed meeting or choose a date without further evidence.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1350: September 1 with supplied 1850 year. Enormous Scanian/Copenhagen fossil lot arrived this morning, not yet fully examined. Anticipates better specimens, stops engraving foreign species and hopes to examine within week. Eight provisional labels listed with explicit uncertainty Nilssonii versus undulatum; do not replace with later correct assignments. Requests rough drawings and status of engravings, no knowledge that each is already engraved. Authorial Read the P.S excluded from projection is a distinct surviving inscription, not instruction to agent. Incoming collection and notes are not reproduced as text.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1354: September 10 with supplied 1850 year. Fresh specimens reveal probable conflation of two species under undulatum; now requests six added views and discusses plate space/deletions. Raw HTML has literal [Diagram] and [/Diagram] enclosing a numbered textual specification, zero image or table nodes; separate diagrams sent are not preserved merely because placeholder exists. Maintain views, sizes and proximity constraints without synthetic image reconstruction. Supplies better validus specimen, requests tracing of altered woodcut, permits extra paid work through Bowerbank. Possible deletions are options, not final omissions: later all Hausmanni figures retained. Proof comparison and London trip remain planned.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1358: September 12 with supplied 1850 year. Approves revised woodcut but corrects upper lateral to Upper Latus with capital L and cardinal to Carinal. Raw text includes capital L instruction; do not merge it into scientific term. Requests four blocks close to type, explains proposed cutter arrangement and actual extra porterage payment. Wants proofs only when all four plates ready, plus woodcut proofs, blocks retained by Sowerby. Later five-plate final volume differs from current four-plate expectation; not an arithmetic error to repair.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1360: September 23 with supplied 1850 year. New German specimen is unfamiliar and near validus; enclosed view initially expected as woodcut because no plate space. P5 revises P1 instruction: instead of sending block first, inspect during intended London proof visit. Requests two proofs of each plate and advance notice, not actual possession. Later artist fits view in plate; preserve original intention rather than final outcome. Dunker/Roemer identification in apparatus is source attribution not preserved incoming cover. Enclosed drawing absent.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1368: November 11 with supplied 1850 year. Replies late to missing Sowerby letter after illness, evaluates received rough proof, requests corrections, divisions and labels, needs rough sheet preserved with final proof. Does not claim all plates received or finished. Fitch missing letter threatens return; several previous apologies, no full prompt text. Changes transport plan to servant and tax-cart for proofs/specimens, reserving Loricula plate for later, asks whether Wetherell specimen returned and gracilis registered parcel received six weeks earlier. Questions are not proof return/delivery happened. Same-date 1369 tells Fitch one of five plates received; both are Darwin outgoing witnesses, not a QA pair.
